title: topologySpreadConstraints labelSelector must match the chart's rendered pod labels
answers: topology spread constraint not spreading pods across zones
all mlflow replicas land in the same availability zone
pods not distributed across AZs despite topologySpreadConstraints
which labels to use in topologySpreadConstraints labelSelector
body:
Symptom: replicas of the MLflow deployment still land in one availability zone even though topologySpreadConstraints is set.
Root cause: the labelSelector in the values does not match the labels on the rendered pods, so the scheduler counts no matching pods for the spread. The chart's pods carry app.kubernetes.io/name and app.kubernetes.io/instance, which the reviewer's evidence shows.
Fix pattern: set the labelSelector.matchLabels in charts/values.yaml to those chart selector labels (app.kubernetes.io/name: mlflow and app.kubernetes.io/instance set to the release name). The commented example in values.yaml shows this form.
Constraints: the selector must match labels the template actually renders on pods, including podLabels. The example uses a release name placeholder, so replace it per install.
applies: Users or chart changes that configure topologySpreadConstraints for the MLflow Helm chart.
says: Replicas in our deployment cluster are all scheduled into the same availability zone.
Server pods fail to spread evenly across availability zones despite zone spread configuration.
Why are all tracking server deployment instances running in a single cloud zone?
Distribute application server replicas evenly across zones by configuring the correct deployment labels.
search: In the MLflow Helm chart, topologySpreadConstraints labelSelector must match the rendered pod labels to prevent replicas from landing in a single availability zone. The labelSelector.matchLabels in charts/values.yaml must be set to charts/templates/deployment.yaml selector labels (app.kubernetes.io/name: mlflow and app.kubernetes.io/instance set to the release name). Applies to users or chart changes configuring topologySpreadConstraints, requiring selectors to match actually rendered labels including podLabels.
